source_proof.finding: Formatter and serialization facade receive &Value only. Native repr discards World/current FileId/context before forwarding. There is no canonical global reference, scope-stack position or source provenance argument.

Full carrier is Arc of name, scope, content, introspection_content, bib_styles and document_info. Constructor initializes the latter four uniformly. No FileId, kind, origin or separate public name is carried.
Expression, document and imported-file global routes independently build Module::new("std", stdlib.clone()); imported-file construction uses current World inputs and effective features.

Imported-file evaluation discards rendered content and returns Module::new(file-derived name, local exports) without metadata/content setters. Thus presence/absence and empty metadata cannot separate imports from global. Principal-document setters at eval/mod.rs:636 do not run on imports.

Aliases preserve Module object/name; wildcard copies every scope binding value in iteration order into the exported top scope. Scope/Binding carry no per-binding origin, span, kind or constness. A lawful std.typ containing #import std: * preserves all std values/order and constructor defaults while remaining a named imported module.

Arc identity is allocation identity, varies among legitimate globals, and cannot classify origins without an external canonical reference. Independently constructing a standard module cannot recover identity of a previous one. Pointer addresses or allocation layout are prohibited oracles.

At the carrier API, Module::new("std", g.scope().clone()) is lawful and preserves all nested value identities from g while giving the same other field defaults and a fresh outer Arc. This is an API-level construction argument, not a claimed Typst constructor or CLI measurement.
Existing diagnostic name rewrite is only name == std; it contains no extra discriminator and cannot justify the formatter fix.
Vanilla stores global as the module name and repr projects that name. Required language output does not require mimicking upstream Rust mechanics.

inference.claim: Within the fixed repr-only scope there is no sound discriminator for std-global versus every ordinary imported std.typ. Name, all content/metadata fields, binding types/order/count/native membership and complete structural stdlib fingerprints are defeated by lawful reexport; pointer identity and fixture heuristics are inadmissible.
inference.falsifier: An existing field or invariant available through the present formatter inputs and exclusive to all legitimate globals across lawful module construction would refute the claim. Complete carrier and construction-route inspection found none.
inference.not_claimed: This is not a proof that parity is impossible after changing construction or other owners. It does not assert general equality of Rust values or addresses.
